def priority(f):
    progress = f['progress']
    cluster_density = f['cluster_density']
    d_amp = 1.0 + 0.25 * cluster_density * (1.0 - 0.3 * progress)
    rw = 0.2 + 0.45 * progress
    rgw = 0.35 - 0.25 * progress
    cl = 0.15 * cluster_density * (1.0 - progress)
    return -d_amp * f['distance'] + rw * f['return_distance'] + rgw * f['regret'] + cl * f['nearest_remaining']
